title: ISO/IEC 27001 / 27701 readiness roadmap
disclaimer: Sertifika/onay iddiası değildir. No ISMS or PIMS has been scoped, implemented, internally audited or externally audited; this is a readiness plan only.

isms.proposal: POSEIDON product company: cloud runtime, development pipeline and customer support boundary (22.01 paragraph:95-97).

pims.proposal: Customer and crew personal data processed by POSEIDON, including crew medical/identity fields and protected safety reports (03.02 paragraph:293).

provider.note: Production IdP, hosting/deployment provider, object storage provider and backup store are not selected (docs/architecture.md). Each becomes a supplier-register entry.

tenant.note: Tenant, vessel and job scope are enforced server-side from the trusted membership; query filters are not the only boundary (docs/security-baseline.md).

data.note: Data inventory, purpose, legal basis, retention and transfer controls per data class are required; AI/embedding providers receive no real customer data by default; pilot telemetry carries pseudonymous buckets only.

auditReadiness.claimRule: A certificate exists only after a formal external audit by an accredited body (22.01 paragraph:122-124).

gaps.area: ISMS scope statement and asset/service inventory
gaps.remaining: Scope statement, asset and service inventory.

gaps.area: Information-security risk register and treatment plan
gaps.remaining: Risk method, register and treatment plan.

gaps.area: Access control: IAM/MFA/privileged access, RBAC/object scope, separation of duties
gaps.remaining: Production IdP/MFA rollout and privileged-access review are open.

gaps.area: Secure SDLC: code, dependency, secret and release controls
gaps.remaining: Written SDLC policy and its periodic review record.
Supplier register, contracts/DPAs and reviews once providers are selected.
Incident response plan, notification timelines and an exercise record.

gaps.area: Business continuity / DR: backup, restore, RTO/RPO
gaps.remaining: Measured restore test and approved RPO/RTO targets (DEV-071 DEFERRED).

gaps.area: Privacy/PIMS: processing inventory, roles, retention and transfer controls
gaps.remaining: Processing inventory, controller/processor roles, retention schedule, transfer assessment, DPIA where needed.
Audit programme, first internal audit and management review.
Accredited body selection after ISO-GAP-01..09 are closed.
